title: Isolation, expansion, differentiation, and histological processing of human nasal epithelial cells
protocol: Have donor blow nose to remove any excess mucous from the nasal cavity.
Slowly insert an interdental brush into the nasal cavity and gently spin it for 10 seconds on the inferior turbinate.
Remove the brush from the handle using wire cutters.
Place the brush into a 5 mL Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL of ACF dissociation solution at 22°C–25°C.
Incubate the Eppendorf tube with the tissue sample in the ACF dissociation solution for digestion.
Repeat steps 1–3 with the donor brushing the opposite nostril and placing the second brush into the same 5 mL Eppendorf tube containing the first brush.
Trim 2–3 mm from a P1000 micropipette tip and insert the cut wire end of the brush into the trimmed pipette tip.
Gently push the pipette down so that the entire brush enters the pipette tip, causing cellular material and mucous to accumulate at the end of the pipette tip.
Press and spin the pipette tip against the side of the Eppendorf tube until the cellular material is suspended in ACF solution.
Discard the pipette tip and brush.
Incubate the Eppendorf at 37°C for 15 minutes, gently flicking the tube halfway through and again at the end of incubation.
Add 1 mL of ACF inhibition solution to the Eppendorf and mix by gently inverting it multiple times.
Centrifuge the sample at 22°C–25°C for 5 minutes at 200 × g.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PneumaCult-Ex Plus media using a P1000 pipette, slowly pipetting to avoid cell death.
Plate cells into one well of a 6-well culture plate containing 1 mL pre-warmed complete Expansion Plus media for a total of 2 mL media.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Refresh the media when colonies are first observed on day 2–4.
On day 5–6 of culture, remove media from wells.
Wash cells briefly with warmed PBS.
Apply 1 mL of ACF Dissociation Solution and incubate plates at 37°C for 6–8 min.
Gently tap on plates to fully dissociate cells.
Apply 1 mL of ACF Inhibition solution to cells and gently swirl the plate to mix.
Transfer the cells to a 15 mL conical tube or 5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 200 × g.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL complete Expansion Plus media using a P1000 micropipette.
Transfer the cell solution to a T25 flask containing 2 mL of complete expansion-plus media for a total of 3 mL media.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Transfer cells to transwell inserts after 8 days of culture.
Collect cells by repeating steps 14–19.
Seed the apical chamber of each transwell insert with 2×10⁵ HNECs in 0.5 mL of complete expansion plus media.
Apply 1 mL of complete expansion plus media to each well containing a transwell insert.
Incubate cultures at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Visually confirm monolayer formation via phase contrast microscopy.
Initiate the ALI by removing media from apical and basal chambers.
Replenish only the basal chamber with 1 mL of ALI media.
Incubate cultures at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Replace ALI media in the basal chamber every 48 hours.
Wash the apical chamber with 0.5 mL PBS to remove cell debris and prevent over-accumulation of muco-substances.
Fix ALI tissue by rinsing apical and basal chambers with PBS.
Apply 1 mL of 10% buffered formalin to the basal chamber and 0.5 mL to the apical chamber.
Wrap plate in parafilm.
Place at 4°C for 12-16 hours.
Rinse inserts with PBS.
Remove the polyester membrane from the transwell inserts using a #11 scalpel blade.
Cut the membrane into two equal halves by inserting the scalpel blade from the underside of the membrane ~3–4mm deep and cutting a vertical line down the center of the insert.
Using the transwell insert as a guide, cut in a circular motion to remove the two halves of the membrane.
Place membrane into 70% ETOH.
Wash on slow rocker for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash membrane in 80% ETOH on slow rocker for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash membrane in 95% ETOH on slow rocker for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash membrane in 100% ETOH on slow rocker for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Wash membrane in Xylene on slow rocker for 15 min at 22°C–25°C.
Place inserts into 55°C molten paraffin wax for 25 min.
Remove ALI tissue from molten wax and gently press tissue between thumb and forefinger to cool the wax/membrane into a flat shape.
Dip wax chip in and out of molten paraffin briefly to add an additional layer of wax.
Use forceps to grip the wax chip from the edge, maintaining a flat shape as it cools.
Briefly dip an ALI membrane in wax 4-6 times to form wax chips.
Repeat dipping the ALI membrane in wax at least 5 times to increase chip thickness between 2-4 mm.
Fill an embedding mold with molten wax and place onto a cryo plate or ice pack.
Insert the wax chip into the mold when the molten wax has partially cooled, ensuring the flat side of the membrane faces down.
Allow the mold to cool on a cryo plate or ice pack until solidified.
Remove wax block from the mold and store at room temperature until future sectioning.
Use microtome to collect 10 μm sections.
Place wax block at room temperature before sectioning to reduce cracking of wax during sectioning.
Use a small paintbrush to prevent each section from curling as it is generated.
Transfer each section to a 55°C water bath using fine forceps.
Pick up floating section using a charged slide.
Dry at room temperature for a minimum of 12 hours before staining.
Store dried sections at room temperature for future analysis if necessary.
Place slides on a 55°C heat block for 10 minutes.
Submerge slide in xylene for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in a second container of Xylene for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 100% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 95% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 80% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 70% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge ALI tissue sections in a container of antigen retrieval buffer within a commercial electronic pressure cooker.
Boil distilled water in the pressure cooker chamber to produce heat and pressure for antigen retrieval.
Process tissue sections for fluorescent immunohistochemistry using modified protocols from standard formalin fixed paraffin embedded methods.
Submerge slide in distilled H2O for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Place slide into a pressure-cooker safe container filled with antigen retrieval buffer.
Fill pressure cooker with distilled water as per the manual’s minimum requirement.
Set pressure cooker to 15 min on High setting.
Carefully vent pressure cooker and remove slide from antigen retrieval buffer.
Submerge slide in distilled H2O for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in TBST for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Carefully dry the slide using a Kimwipe, being sure not to touch the section of ALI tissue.
Use a hydrophobic pen to draw a barrier around the section of ALI tissue with 5 mm margins.
Pipette 50–100 μL of Blocking Solution directly onto the section of ALI tissue.
Incubate for 60 min at 22°C–25°C in a humidified chamber.
Remove blocking solution from sections by gently tapping the side of the slide on a paper towel.
Use a Kimwipe to remove any remaining solution, being sure not to touch ALI tissue.
Dilute primary Ab to desired concentration in 1% BSA-TBST solution.
Apply 50–100 μL of primary antibody solution directly onto the section of ALI tissue.
Incubate for 60 min at 22°C–25°C in a humidified chamber.
Remove primary antibody solution from sections by gently tapping the side of the slide on a paper towel.
Use a Kimwipe to remove any remaining solution.
Submerge slide in TBST for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Carefully dry the slide using a Kimwipe, being sure not to touch the section of ALI tissue.
Dilute fluorescent secondary antibodies to desired concentration in 1% BSA –TBST solution.
Apply 50–100 μL of secondary antibody solution directly onto the section of ALI tissue.
Incubate for 60 min at 22°C–25°C in a darkened humidified chamber.
Remove secondary antibody solution from sections by gently tapping the side of the slide on a paper towel.
Use a Kimwipe to remove any remaining solution.
Submerge slide in TBST for 5 min at 22°C–25°C.
Carefully dry the slide using a Kimwipe, being sure not to touch the section of ALI tissue.
Place one small drop of ProLong Gold antifade with DAPI directly onto the ALI tissue section.
Gently apply glass coverslip over the sample.
Seal the coverslip by applying clear nail polish around the edges.
Visualize with a fluorescent microscope.
Store slides away from light at 4°C.
Submerge slide in hematoxylin for 1 minute.
Gently rinse slide with tap-water for 5–7 seconds.
Submerge slide in 80% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 95% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in 100% ETOH for 5 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Submerge slide in eosin for 30 seconds.
Gently rinse slide with 95% ETOH.
Submerge slide in 95% ETOH for 30 seconds.
Submerge slide in 100% ETOH for 30 seconds.
Apply mounting media and cover slip.
Visualize tissue with a light microscope.
